rules_text: When extracting or formatting dates, always convert all variations (e.g., "Month Day, Year" or "Month Day Year") into the ISO 8601 standard format (YYYY-MM-DD).
Ensure proper capitalization for all proper nouns, including names, company names, and specific locations, when generating text.

When identifying multiple parties, the system must accurately parse and list all named entities, ensuring correct pluralization and distinguishing between corporate and individual roles. Do not default to only extracting the first or most prominent entity when multiple parties are present in the source text.
